title: Two-Fidelity Best-Action Identification for Stochastic Minimax Tree
abstract: arXiv:2606.01708v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study fixed-confidence best-action identification (BAI) in stochastic minimax trees. This problem is increasingly relevant in modern AI planning, where deep minimax search and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with language model long rollouts face a fundamental tradeoff: heuristic evaluations are cheap but biased, while accurate rollouts are reliable but prohibitively expensive. We propose 2FFS, a two-fidelity tree-search algorithm that brings multi-fidelity flat bandit ideas into trees. The algorithm combines minimax-style fast expansion with MCTS-style stochastic sampling, adaptively deciding when to exploit cheap biased evaluations and when to invoke expensive accurate evaluations for local certification. We prove fixed-confidence correctness, establish finite stopping for exact identification, and give a polynomial-depth cost upper bound for general-depth trees. translated_title: 随机极小极大树的双保真度最优动作识别
translated_abstract: 我们研究随机极小极大树中固定置信度最优动作识别（BAI）问题。这一问题在现代AI规划中日益重要：深度极小极大搜索与结合语言模型长展开的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）面临一个根本性权衡——启发式评估廉价但有偏，而精确展开可靠但成本高昂。我们提出2FFS，一种双保真度树搜索算法，将多保真度平坦老虎机思想引入树搜索中。该算法将极小极大式的快速扩展与MCTS式的随机采样相结合，自适应地决定何时利用廉价的有偏评估、何时调用昂贵而精确的评估来进行局部认证。我们证明了该算法的固定置信度正确性，建立了精确识别的有限停止性，并给出了一般深度树的深度多项式成本上界。在数值随机树实验中，2FFS使用的预算远少于基线方法。
tldr: 提出双保真度树搜索算法2FFS，将极小极大式快速扩展与MCTS式随机采样结合，在随机极小极大树的最优动作识别任务中自适应权衡廉价有偏评估与昂贵精确评估，同时保证固定置信度正确性、有限停止性以及深度多项式的成本上界。
